cases.name: CHK-001 adversarial: git add failure is surfaced instead of swallowed
cases.execute:
const { mkdtempSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync, rmSync } = await import('fs'); const { tmpdir } = await import('os'); const { join } = await import('path'); const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const temp = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'koala-index-lock-')); const cli = $root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js'; const run = (command, payload, cwd = $root) => { const args = [cli, '--root', temp, command]; if (payload !== undefined) args.push(JSON.stringify(payload)); return execFileSync('node', args, { cwd, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }); }; try { mkdirSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'story', 'actives'), { recursive: true }); mkdirSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'requirements'), { recursive: true }); writeFileSync(join(temp, 'koala.config.json'), JSON.stringify({ scanRoot: 'packages/main', rootDir: 'src', outDir: 'packages/main/dist', testsDir: 'packages/main/tests', fixturesDir: 'packages/main/tests/fixtures', storyDir: 'docs/story/actives', requirementsDir: 'docs/requirements', storyPrefix: 'B' }, null, 2)); writeFileSync(join(temp, '.gitignore'), '.worktrees
'); writeFileSync(join(temp, 'README.md'), '# temp
'); execFileSync('git', ['init', '-b', 'main'], { cwd: temp, stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }); execFileSync('git', ['config', 'user.name', 'Koala Test'], { cwd: temp, stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }); execFileSync('git', ['config', 'user.email', 'koala@example.com'], { cwd: temp, stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }); execFileSync('git', ['add', '.'], { cwd: temp, stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }); execFileSync('git', ['commit', '-m', 'init'], { cwd: temp, stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }); const created = run('story_create', { name: 'index-lock', title: 'Index lock story', description: 'Verify git add failure is surfaced.', type: 'feature', priority: 'high', checklist: [{ title: 'bootstrap worktree', context: 'index lock regression case' }] }); const storyId = created.match(/B-[a-f0-9]+/)[0]; writeFileSync(join(temp, '.git', 'index.lock'), 'locked
'); const out = run('story_advance', { storyId, phase: 'INIT_CHECK' }); return { warned: out.includes('⚠ worktree 创建失败'), surfacedIndexLock: out.includes('index.lock') }; } finally { rmSync(temp, { recursive: true, force: true }); }

cases.name: CHK-002 adversarial: stale branch is rejected before bad worktree is created
cases.execute: const { mkdtempSync, mkdirSync, writeFileSync, rmSync, existsSync, readFileSync } = await import('fs'); const { tmpdir } = await import('os'); const { join } = await import('path'); const { execFileSync } = await import('child_process'); const temp = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), 'koala-bad-branch-')); const cli = $root + '/packages/main/dist/cli.js'; const run = (command, payload, cwd = $root) => { const args = [cli, '--root', temp, command]; if (payload !== undefined) args.push(JSON.stringify(payload)); return execFileSync('node', args, { cwd, encoding: 'utf8', stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }); }; try { mkdirSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'story', 'actives'), { recursive: true }); mkdirSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'requirements'), { recursive: true }); writeFileSync(join(temp, 'koala.config.json'), JSON.stringify({ scanRoot: 'packages/main', rootDir: 'src', outDir: 'packages/main/dist', testsDir: 'packages/main/tests', fixturesDir: 'packages/main/tests/fixtures', storyDir: 'docs/story/actives', requirementsDir: 'docs/requirements', storyPrefix: 'B' }, null, 2)); writeFileSync(join(temp, '.gitignore'), '.worktrees\n'); writeFileSync(join(temp, 'README.md'), '# temp\n'); execFileSync('git', ['init', '-b', 'main'], { cwd: temp, stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }); execFileSync('git', ['config', 'user.name', 'Koala Test'], { cwd: temp, stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }); execFileSync('git', ['config', 'user.email', 'koala@example.com'], { cwd: temp, stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }); execFileSync('git', ['add', '.'], { cwd: temp, stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }); execFileSync('git', ['commit', '-m', 'init'], { cwd: temp, stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }); const created = run('story_create', { name: 'bad-branch', title: 'Bad branch story', description: 'Verify stale branch is rejected before a bad worktree is created.', type: 'feature', priority: 'high', checklist: [{ title: 'bootstrap worktree', context: 'bad branch regression case' }] }); const storyId = created.match(/B-[a-f0-9]+/)[0]; execFileSync('git', ['branch', 'story/' + storyId], { cwd: temp, stdio: ['pipe', 'pipe', 'pipe'] }); const out = run('story_advance', { storyId, phase: 'INIT_CHECK' }); const index = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(temp, 'docs', 'story', 'actives', storyId, 'index.json'), 'utf8')); return { warned: out.includes('⚠ worktree 创建失败'), clearMessage: out.includes('不包含 docs/story/actives'), noBadWorktree: !existsSync(join(temp, '.worktrees', storyId)), metadataCleared: !index.worktree }; } finally { rmSync(temp, { recursive: true, force: true }); }
